content.user_title: Build Safer Ad Placement Exclusion Plans
content.value_statement: Unsafe or irrelevant ad placements can damage brands and waste campaign spend. This skill converts placement reports and safety requirements into documented exclusion plans.
actual_capabilities: Reviews placement reports for low-quality, irrelevant, off-brand, and made-for-advertising inventory.
Creates site, app, channel, and placement exclusion lists with a rationale for each decision.
Recommends Search Partner, Display expansion, and Audience Network opt-outs based on campaign goals.
Defines content-suitability tiers and sensitive-topic blocks from stated brand requirements.
References existing audience suppression sets without rebuilding or changing them.
Packages placement evidence and exclusion decisions for a separate A1 audit.
limitations: Requires a placements report to build complete A1 evidence.
Does not create targeted audiences or derive audience suppression segments.
Does not calculate RQS scores or issue Pass, Partial, or Fail verdicts.
Does not require direct access to advertising platform APIs.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Campaign Launch
use_cases.description: Create placement, network, and topic exclusions before campaign spend begins.

use_cases.title: Standardize Brand Safety
use_cases.description: Translate company safety policies into reusable platform exclusion requirements.

use_cases.title: Package Audit Evidence
use_cases.description: Combine placement data and documented decisions for an independent A1 review.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Exclusions
prompt_templates.prompt: Build brand-safety exclusions for [campaign goal] on [platform]. Apply these constraints: [constraints].
prompt_templates.scenario: Starting with campaign goals and written safety rules

prompt_templates.title: Review a Placements Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this placements report for [account]. List exclusions with one rationale each and label measured versus user-provided decisions: [report].
prompt_templates.scenario: Analyzing where ads served or could serve

prompt_templates.title: Set Network and Content Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend network opt-outs, content-suitability tiers, and sensitive-topic blocks for [goal]. Explain each reach and safety tradeoff.
prompt_templates.scenario: Balancing inventory reach with brand controls

prompt_templates.title: Package A1 Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Package A1 evidence from these placement and campaign exports: [inputs]. Reference the existing audience exclusions at [reference]. Do not assign an audit verdict.
prompt_templates.scenario: Preparing a complete handoff for an account auditor

output_examples.input: Exclude unsafe inventory for a family-focused retail campaign using the supplied placements report.
output: Placement exclusion: example channel, measured from report, repeated unsuitable content.
Content block: tragedy and sensitive social issues, required by the stated policy.
Network decision: disable automatic expansion until controlled inventory meets performance requirements.

output_examples.input: Prepare A1 evidence, but no placements report is available.
output_examples.output: NEEDS_INPUT: Provide the native placements report. Campaign settings alone cannot establish where ads served or could serve.

output_examples.input: Package exclusions when an audience suppression set already exists.
output_examples.output: The evidence package references the existing suppression set unchanged and documents placement, network, and content controls separately.

best_practices: Provide a native placements report and name the campaign goal before requesting exclusions.
Separate measured placement evidence from policy-based exclusions in every decision.
Review proposed files before confirming any save to workspace memory.
anti_patterns: Do not infer safe placements from campaign settings when the placements report is missing.
Do not rebuild audience suppression segments inside this workflow.
Do not treat the evidence package as an A1 audit verdict.

faq.question: Which inputs are required?
faq.answer: Provide the account or campaign goal, platforms, brand-safety constraints, and a native placements report.

faq.question: What happens without a placements report?
faq.answer: The skill marks the evidence as NEEDS_INPUT and requests the report instead of assuming safety.

faq.question: Does this skill change advertising accounts?
faq.answer: No. It creates exclusion recommendations and evidence from supplied information.

faq.question: Can it build audience exclusions?
faq.answer: No. It references an existing audience suppression set produced by the audience-segment workflow.

faq.question: Does it issue the A1 verdict?
faq.answer: No. It packages evidence for a separate account auditor to evaluate.

faq.question: Are advertising platform APIs required?
faq.answer: No. Manual exports are sufficient, while platform API connectors remain optional.
